\begin{document}
With $\beta>0$, the occupation obeys
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{e^{\beta x}+1} + \frac{1}{e^{-\beta x}+1} = 2 .
\label{eq:a}
\end{equation}
and also
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{e^{\beta x}+1} - \frac{1}{2} = -\frac{1}{2}\tanh\frac{\beta x}{2} .
\label{eq:a}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
